# KoalaStuff

> Small open-source tools for real annoyances. No tracking, no SaaS fluff, no accounts. Developed by Timo.

## Useful Links
- Website: https://koalastuff.net
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shik3i
- Dev.to: https://dev.to/hungrykoala
- Mastodon: https://mastodon.social/@koalastuff

## Overview
KoalaStuff is a project hub and blog featuring browser extensions, web tools, and desktop applications designed to solve real-world problems. All tools are open-source (MIT licensed) and focused on maximum user privacy, self-hostability, and local-first execution.

---

## Active Projects

### KoalaSync (Browser Extension)
- **Description:** Browser watch parties for any video. Syncs video playback (play, pause, seeking) across YouTube, Netflix, Emby, Jellyfin, Plex, and more. Features local Web Audio API dynamics compression for normalizing audio volume (quiet dialogue vs. loud explosions).
- **Web App:** https://sync.koalastuff.net
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaSync
- **Chrome Web Store:** https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/koalasync/obbnmkmlaaddodakcbdljknjpagklifc
- **Firefox Add-ons:** https://addons.mozilla.org/de/firefox/addon/koalasync/

### KoalaShip (Web Application)
- **Description:** An open-source parcel-delivery and online shopping simulation. Recreates browsing, shopping, tracking, and unboxing without spending real money.
- **Website:** https://ship.koalastuff.net
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaShip

### KoalaPull (Desktop Application)
- **Description:** A native cross-platform desktop download manager (macOS, Windows, Linux) built on top of yt-dlp and ffmpeg. Features automatic setup of dependencies, format selection, preset management, and a queue. Local-only, no telemetry.
- **Website:** https://pull.koalastuff.net
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaPull

### KoalaStartpage (Web Application)
- **Description:** A personal bento-box startpage and server dashboard.
- **Website:** https://start.koalastuff.net
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaStartpage

### KoalaSnippets (Web Application)
- **Description:** A self-hostable Svelte/Tailwind developer code snippet manager.
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaSnippets

---

## Other Projects & Experiments

- **KoalaClicker (WIP Browser Extension):** Privacy-first auto-clicker for active browser tabs. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaClicker)
- **KoalaCookies (WIP Browser Extension):** Lightweight cookie editor and manager. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaCookies)
- **KoalaFlyff (WIP Browser Extension):** Forward keystrokes to a background tab to play two game accounts concurrently. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Shik3i/FlyffUniverseHelper)
- **KoalaSound (Experimental Browser Extension):** Real-time Chromium audio processing presets. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaSound)

---

## Blog & Articles
KoalaStuff includes a static blog hosting dev logs and technical guides. Main articles include:
- **caddy-reverse-proxy-tutorial:** Setting up a Caddy reverse proxy for local developer domains.
- **local-audio-compressor:** Implementation details of building a browser DynamicsCompressorNode.
- **vibe-coding-saved-me:** Thoughts on generative AI pair programming.
- **koalastuff-new-home:** Why koalastuff.net was rebuilt into a project hub.
